home.text:
Only use Frontline Pools if you want perfection!
Our children have grown, so we didn't bother to remodel our pool, but time took its toll. Our shell was sound, but nothing else. The pool had old glass block that was unsightly and leaking, worn travertine, inoperative pool features, broken pumps, filters, and heater. This was in addition to resurfacing and retiling the entire pool, wading pool and hot tub so it was not a basic refinishing. The pool overflows from the wading and hot tub areas had to be completely rebuilt with a concrete wall and tiled. A water feature was installed, and others terminated; new travertine installed on the spillover, and new LED multicolored lights where they previously did not exist. Lastly, a seamless phone APP to control every feature in the pool including pumps, hot tub, lights, and timers all on your iPhone. Jacob and Matthew delivered everything they promised, and in a shorter time than anticipated, all in about 6-8 weeks. They are extremely knowledgeable in every facet of pool building, including waterproofing the entire pool before it was coated and finished. There were no additional costs added to their proposal, so there were no surprises along the way although we did add some additional items by choice. I can't think of a better, more trustworthy company than Frontline. Thank you Jacob and Matthew, we are extremely happy with our pool.
